title: Vector P1: merge-on-commit (same-color union / different-color cut, top-wins) behind flag
description: Depends on Vector P0 (planar kernel). Implement Flash 8 MERGE drawing on commit for merge-mode shapes. Replace the dead/MVP merge-drawing.ts with TRUE planar union (same fill color -> single region) and CUT (different color -> top wins, underlying overlapped area destroyed) using the P0 planar kernel, curve-preserving. Wire into Shell.tsx handleShapeCreated (~1448) for type:'shape' ONLY (drawing-object stays append, unchanged). On commit: fold the new shape into the layer's planar arrangement, then convert back to per-path closed loops for storage/.fla/SWF (per-path stays the interchange format). Put behind a feature flag (default off until P5 cutover). VERIFY: build + tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixtures acceptable); Ruffle PIXEL oracle (acceptance truth): 'draw red over blue cuts blue beneath', 'draw blue over blue = one merged region (drag selects whole union)'; area-conservation unit tests. Update docs/36-vector-merge-model.md. ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry. Conflict hotspots: Shell.tsx, engine/merge-drawing.ts, engine/index.ts. Sequential after P0.
